label: molecules
quotes: Card
Card is a UI component module providing a reusable Card presentational element, with no recorded requirements yet.
Carousel
A carousel component that renders a scrollable, navigable track of items for presenting a sequence of content.
CaseItem
Renders a single case entry as a UI component.
Dialog
Dialog is a UI component module providing a modal dialog element gated on a non-null dialog state, exported for use elsewhere in the design system.
Field
Field is a molecule component in the design system that renders a labeled form input wrapper, combining a label with its associated control element.
Footer
The Footer module defines a React component that renders the page's footer section.
Grid
Grid is a UI component providing the grid layout element for the application interface.
Lists
A minimal component module that renders the Lists view with no recorded requirements or further implementation detail available.
Menu
The Menu module defines the Menu component responsible for rendering an application menu interface.
Metric
A UI component module representing a single metric display, with no further module-specific documentation available.
NavMobile
Renders the mobile navigation panel used by the site's responsive navigation UI.
Question
The Question module provides the Question component, with no further details recorded about its implementation or purpose.
